text.en:
The following Muslim returnees who have successfully completed the Second Leadership
Training Program conducted jointly by the Mindanao Executive Development Academy and the Southern
Philippine Development Authority are hereby conferred Sub-professional Civil Service Eligibility which shall
qualify them for appointment to first level positions in the Civil Service.

The civil service eligibility granted under this Decree shall prescribe in the manner provided
under Section 19(a) of Presidential Decree No. 807.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
